posts.text: Colts Jonathan Taylor wants to make the Steelers pay: “When you have a front like that, you don’t really have to send too many pressures, you just let those guys up front eat. So, it’s going to be important for us to be on our alignment, assignment, and technique. Because, when you have talented guys like that up front, it allows them to play coverage on the back end because they have so much confidence in their guys up front. So, we gotta be ready for it, but we gotta make them pay. We’ve got to say, if you’re just gonna rush four, if you’re just gonna play basic, standard things, you’re gonna have to pay for it. But, like I said, they’ve got the personnel. They’ve got the personnel and the guys that are able to get it done. So, it’s gonna be about execution.” #Steelers #NFL

posts.author: Blitz_Burgh@sportsbots.xyz
posts.text: Analyst Conor Orr on the Heed the Call podcast says he hopes the Colts put the Steelers out of their misery: “Clearly, you have communication issues. Your coach came out and said your house is dirty and you need to clean your house. Something’s a mess here. Say it’s a goddamn mess. I’m sick of Rodgers. I’m sick of watching this team. I’m sick of watching the receivers drop balls. I’m sick of them having played one good game against the Bengals, so we’ve got to take them seriously for another three weeks. Come on, Jonathan Taylor. Put up 400 yards and put this old, dying horse out of its misery and off my screen.” #Steelers #NFL

posts.author: Blitz_Burgh@sportsbots.xyz
posts.text: Mike McCarthy on working with the new guys the Steelers brought in: “The new guys really have only had one day. We were actually talking about the roster right before I came out here. The biggest thing is having a plan for those guys and making sure they're getting work so we can evaluate them. We have a full week to see how things play out for the Colts game. Like all of our players dealing with injuries, they're working through it, so we'll see how that goes. But I've really only had one day with them, and most of my impressions are based on conversations. We're glad they're here, but as far as how much we'll use them, that will be determined by the end of the week.” #Steelers #NFL

posts.author: Blitz_Burgh@sportsbots.xyz
posts.text: Mike McCarthy details their third-down issues: “I think it's execution. If you execute well enough on first and second down, you put yourself in those positions. But that's the first step. The first step is creating the opportunities to be in those situations. Our numbers are really good on third-and-2, third-and-3, third-and-4, third-and-5, and third-and-6. But yes, we clearly have to be better in that area.” #Steelers #NFL

posts.author: Blitz_Burgh@sportsbots.xyz
posts.text: Mike McCarthy on Roman Wilson’s Growth: “Roman has a second gear that you love to utilize as much as possible. I think the discipline of route running is a big part of it. Obviously, you have the releases and the discipline that comes with those, but it's also about really understanding the stem, resetting the stem, and having the patience and discipline to fully get to the breaking point. You don't want to feel like you have to hit that second gear all the time because his ability to separate is top-notch. I think he's learning the discipline required in the different parts of each route, and he's definitely improving.” #Steelers #NFL

posts.author: Blitz_Burgh@sportsbots.xyz
posts.text: Mike McCarthy explains why Aaron Rodgers has been sacked 13 times (most in the NFL): “Well, you've kind of answered the question there. It's a combination of reasons. I think having the opportunity to go through the specifics of everything, that's what we focus on. When you throw the ball, you have to have a philosophy of protection first and how you approach it. This game will probably be a little different just because of the weather we're getting ready to deal with. But that's all part of why you take the time to go through the self-scout. There are a number of things we can be better at.” #Steelers #NFL

Horn is seeking a second opinion. But he’s likely to land on injured reserve and miss significant time.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text:
Bucs QB Baker Mayfield underwent tests that showed no fracture and no tendon or ligament damage in his right thumb, sources tell The Ringer and Netflix Sports. 

Mayfield will need to regain strength after Sunday’s dislocation and likely will miss some time. But good news overall.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text:
By trading J.J. McCarthy now, the Vikings save over $4.6M in cash and cap space and get an unconditional fifth-round pick in the next draft that, depending how the Giants finish, could end up being a top-150 selection.

Meanwhile, New York adds another former first-round pick QB.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text:
Trade! The Vikings are sending QB J.J. McCarthy to the Giants for a 2027 fifth-round pick, sources tell The Ringer and Netflix Sports.

With Jaxson Dart out for the regular season, New York adds another young QB, while Minnesota gains flexibility and McCarthy gets a fresh start.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text: The 49ers are signing veteran DT Naquan Jones off the Vikings practice squad, per source.

posts.author: NFL.com
posts.text: NFL Week 3 injury report: Player statuses for all 16 games - NFL.com

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text: Giants QB Jaxson Dart is getting additional medical opinions on his injured knee that will determine whether to have surgery, which in turn will determine whether he can return this season or not. For now, he’s out indefinitely, as ESPN reported. Jameis Winston takes over as QB1.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text: The Falcons placed CB A.J. Terrell on injured reserve.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text: Seahawks RB Jadarian Price, who left today’s game at Arizona with a chest injury, had X-rays that came back negative. More tests Monday, but there’s optimism he avoided any significant injury.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text:
Commanders QB Jayden Daniels dislocated his left elbow again, coach Dan Quinn confirmed, adding that an X-ray didn’t show a fracture.

More tests to come Monday, but Daniels will be out for some time: “We’ll rally around Marcus (Mariota).”

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text: The Commanders have officially ruled out QB Jayden Daniels with a left elbow injury.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text: Ladd McConkey is officially active.

posts.author: NFL.com
posts.text: Raiders RB Ashton Jeanty believed to have sprained ankle - NFL.com

posts.author: schultzreport.bsky.social
posts.text: Sources: The #Seahawks are signing veteran QB Drew Lock, bringing him back to Seattle for a second stint. He will backup Sam Darnold.

posts.author: schultzreport.bsky.social
posts.text:
Sources: Colorado QB Shedeur Sanders is scheduled to visit the #Raiders early next week. 

Las Vegas holds the No. 6 pick in the draft. They have been doing work on QBs and have other QB prospects also coming into their building.

posts.author: schultzreport.bsky.social
posts.text: Spoke with an NFL assistant GM about Alabama QB Jalen Milroe: “He’s one of the most intriguing guys in the entire draft. There’s a narrative that he’s just a running quarterback, but that’s way off...

posts.author: schultzreport.bsky.social
posts.text:
Former #Bucs OC Byron Leftwich is back in coaching as he is joining Deion Sanders’ staff at Colorado.

Leftwich interviewed for multiple NFL jobs this past cycle (Pats HC, Seahawks OC) but now makes the move to college.

posts.author: kimberleymartin.bsky.social
posts.text: #Bears GM Ryan Poles, via team statement: “This morning, after meeting with George and Kevin, we informed Matt of our decision to move in a different direction with the leadership of our football team and the head coaching position…”

posts.author: kimberleymartin.bsky.social
posts.text:
Matt Eberflus at 9:30a: “I’m confident I’ll be prepping for SF and coaching this team.”

Matt Eberflus at noon: FIRED.

(Why would the #Bears let that man address reporters, knowing he wouldn’t make it thru the week, let alone the day?)

posts.author: kimberleymartin.bsky.social
posts.text: Will this game be over before I have to leave for Cincinnati on Saturday 🫠

posts.author: jglazer.bsky.social
posts.text: Ok, finally dipping my toe in these waters. I realllllly hope this is way less of a negative cesspool than X!
